name: 2g MKX Disposable *LIMITED EDITION* WC26 - Star Spangled Sorbet - Hybrid
description: Inspired by the world’s favorite game, this limited-time release brings international flavor straight to the lineup. Three countries. Three unique flavor experiences. From Spain to the USA to the United Kingdom, each strain delivers its own signature profile — no passport required. Step up, tap in, and take your taste buds for a spin around the world. Star Spangled Sorbet delivers a smooth, flavorful experience with the perfect balance of uplifting energy and mellow relaxation. Creamy fruit flavors combine with cool icy notes for a refreshing inhale and silky finish that keeps every hit light and satisfying. This balanced hybrid promotes a happy, focused mindset while maintaining a calm, easygoing vibe, making it ideal for anytime enjoyment. Flavor Notes: Cream, Fruit, Ice
